title: The Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, nearly 300 years on the Mediterranean #Armenia
description:
From 1080 to 1375, the Armenian Kingdom of Cilicia, or Lesser Armenia, embodied Armenian sovereignty on the Mediterranean: the coronation of Leo I in 1198, the agreement with the Mongols, the port of Ayas visited by Marco Polo.
